name: Kyoushuujo no Onee-san
source:
Main character enters prestigious driving school to obtain a long-awaited car license. Beautiful female instructors, unique stuff and attractive women students wait for him there - a dozen of girls!
Will he be able to concentrate and get his license? Or is there something here to gain apart of license?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公进入一所名门驾校，准备取得期盼已久的汽车驾照。美丽的女教练、个性十足的工作人员和魅力非凡的女学员都在那里等着他——足足有十几位女孩！
他能否集中精神，顺利拿到驾照？还是说，除了驾照之外，这里还有别的收获？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
